overview: Sumi is a single productivity hub bundling a calculator, currency converter, chess, carrom, Japanese karuta cards, Hiragana/Katakana/Kanji study, Chinese character study, and a notes app behind one responsive dashboard.
features: Standard calculator with history and keyboard support
Live currency converter with swap and rate timestamps
Full legal-move chess with check, checkmate, and move history
Carrom board with striker physics and two-player scoring
Japanese karuta card practice with score and streaks
Hiragana, Katakana, and Kanji study charts and flashcards with saved progress
Chinese character reference and flashcards with saved progress
Rich-text notes with search, pinning, and per-user storage
Internet Identity sign-in with per-user notes and study progress
Light and dark theme with responsive collapsible navigation
